text:
lucy.sales: Borealis POC (dedicated-us-east) - demo team says first-token latency spiked after switching to q4_kv-optimized. Demo in 4h, they’re nervous. Can we triage quickly?

omar.eng: Which endpoint and deployment id? Any sample payload?

lucy.sales: Endpoint /v1/generate, deployment=dedicated-use-12, model=redwood/q4_kv-opt. Sample body: {"model":"redwood/q4_kv-opt","input":"List invoices for acct 88"}

tara.ml: Short checklist: 1) Are they embedding per-request unique tokens in prompt? 2) batch_window too low? 3) prefetch off? Those kill TTFT.

ben.runtime: Pulled config: batch_window_ms=7, max_batch_size=48, prefetch=false, kv_ttl=60s. Also saw many logs: `kv_cache: miss key=conv:borealis:*` and `serving: batch_size=1 queue_wait=820ms`.

omar.eng: Ask customer to stop putting session timestamps in prompt and use x-session header. Meanwhile we can bump batch_window and enable prefetch.

lucy.sales: I messaged them; they said session id includes unix ms for tracing. They'll change if needed.

ben.runtime: Pushing quick patch: batch_window_ms=30, prefetch=true, kv_ttl=300s for dedicated-use-12. ops-bot: change requested by ben.runtime.

ops-bot: rollout started.

ops-bot: rollout complete.

ben.runtime: Replayed 120 requests: median TTFT -> 145ms (was ~760ms), 95p -> 260ms. Cache miss rate down from 46% -> 10%.

tara.ml: Recommend we keep prefetch on for this deployment and add onboarding warning if prompts contain high-entropy tokens. Also propose SDK snippet to stash session IDs in headers.

lucy.sales: I'll follow up on reserved commit / pricing options and send SOC2 + peering docs; customer happy with improvement. Closing blocker but leaving notes for next steps.

ben.runtime: Filed RUNTIME-5017 to add automated detect for high prefix variance and suggested config change.
